title: Compact start works
moves: Avenue, 6 streets, 3 cross streets, neighbor link
happened: Built the whole starter block on day one with a $10,000 bond: thin bands of homes, shops and factories next to each other, power lines through every band. By Jan 2001: 1,650 people (attempt 1 had 20) and only 7% unemployed.
watching: Water spare capacity (the game's graph) was already down to 21%.

title: 5,000 people in two years
happened: Population 1,650 -> 5,140 with almost no unemployment. Took a second $10,000 bond and built a second block of bands to the south.
watching: Water spare capacity; power plant capacity.
